crossRefs.note: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go…
The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.”…
Joab sent to Tekoa, and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on…
“Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces, that they may be…

translations.web: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.
translations.bsb: and the prophet went and waited on the road for the king, disguising himself with a bandage over his eyes.
translations.kjv: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
translations.asv: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.
